description: The current macro regime (GREEN / YELLOW / RED) and business cycle (SPRING / SUMMER / FALL / WINTER) with the evidence behind them: the detail behind the Regime and Business cycle cards of get_dashboard. The regime combines consumer mood (U Michigan sentiment) with money (the global-liquidity condition), and the money condition changes only after two consecutive weekly reads agree: data.details.liquidity_condition shows this week's raw read, the held class, how many agreeing reads are still needed, and the margin to the line. The business cycle crosses growth with prices. Growth is a vote of factory output (IPMAN trend), jobs (initial claims) and investment (BEA real investment in information-processing equipment and software), two of three deciding, and the season changes only when two prints in a row agree: data.cycle carries the vote, the dated prints and held_since. The response opens with the Jawz Dashboard card: the six-reading card as markdown at the top of presentation.display_markdown (above a horizontal rule), the same object at data.read, and the card as a PNG image content block after the text. Below the card, display_markdown carries the regime write-up and its tables (regime inputs, the growth vote, the growth and inflation composites, asset-class tilts); 'tables' is their structured form and 'data' holds the raw values. A 'provenance' block lists each input with its as-of date and age in days. get_indicator_history gives the regime, the cycle or any of their rows over time.
